method: idf-weighted title-token containment of each child spec title against the parent course's spec titles (identical to the P4 decision-matrix probe); containment >= 0.55 maps the child spec to its best parent spec; below-threshold specs stay honestly unmapped and are listed in unmappedChildSpecs. Deterministic — same spines, same map.
parentRowBasis: only owner-approved rows (reviewed:true) of the parent course's external lanes (video-map.draft.external.json + video-map.draft.external-p2e.json where present) are eligible for inheritance
